steps.title: Initialize App Metadata and Build Environment
steps.description: Configure Gradle build settings, target SDK 34, Temurin 17 compatibility and project metadata.

steps.title: Define Backend API Schema
steps.description: Specify cloud schema with collections for user game profiles and payment verification screenshots.

steps.title: Configure Manifest and System Permissions
steps.description: Setup AndroidManifest.xml with activities, Internet and external storage access.

steps.title: Create Color Schemes and Mountain Theme Styles
steps.description: Define aesthetic color palettes, mountain terrain hues, and Material styles.

steps.title: Implement Cloud Backend and Image Worker Network Clients
steps.description: Build native Java network handlers for TrumpleDroid generic backend API and Private Image Worker.

steps.title: Build Dynamic Hill Runner 2D Canvas Engine
steps.description: Implement Pahadi mountain terrain rendering, procedural slopes, runner character, physics, obstacles, and coin collection.

steps.title: Build Authentication and Password Reset Interfaces
steps.description: Implement Login, Registration, and OTP Gmail verification screens.

steps.title: Implement Payment Screenshot Verification Activity
steps.description: Build payment interface with UPI QR details, gallery screenshot picker, under 200KB compression, and Private Image Worker upload.

steps.title: Construct Main Game Dashboard and Run Counter Controller
steps.description: Build game dashboard enforcing 3 free runs, displaying 50 rupee coins, and routing to screenshot recharge when limit expires.

steps.title: Building Pahadi Runner
steps.description: Final compilation and packaging of Pahadi Runner APK.
